title: Autopoietic Project Generation
description:
template_autopoiesis is a combinatoric grammar that deterministically generates
whole runnable projects — not files or snippets, but complete, independently
testable child repositories with their own kernel source, tests, analysis
entry point, and manuscript. A single integer seed plus a grammar of orthogonal
slots (primitive domain, analytical track, section set, and three
presentation/provenance slots) selects one child from a combinatoric product
space of 360 nominal (45 content-distinct)
configurations, via a SHA-256 digest of the seed and slot identity — with no
random-number generator anywhere in the expansion path.

Project generators routinely claim completeness, determinism, and
traceability without making any of the three independently checkable. This
exemplar treats each claim as a structural property to verify rather than a
rhetorical one to assert: verify_child() recomputes a tree hash from the
files actually on disk and compares it against the recorded provenance,
rather than trusting a value the same run wrote down; a honesty manifest
inspects the live source AST to confirm every claim in this manuscript
resolves to a real function in a real file; and a per-domain mutation gate
checks that the acceptance tests reject a constant-success stub before
trusting that they accept the real kernel. The same discipline governs this
document itself — every number below is substituted at render time from a
live measurement rather than hand-typed as a literal.

Across 5 heterogeneous primitive domains
(- optimization
- dynamics
- statistics
- signal
- graph), 493 tests exercise both fixed ground-truth
checks and Hypothesis-driven property invariants at 96.28% branch
coverage, with an explicit negative control per domain distinguishing the
real kernel from a deliberately-wrong one.

Generation pipeline

- Total product size: 360
- Reserved slots: 3 (figure_profile, qr_profile, integrity_profile)

methods.name: Combinatoric slot grammar in config.yaml with SHA-256 grammar hash
methods.description: A grammar of orthogonal slots and options is parsed and validated by parse_grammar(); its canonical JSON is hashed to fingerprint the grammar.
methods.evidence: Grammar.grammar_hash is the truncated SHA-256 of a sort_keys=True JSON canonicalization of the whole grammar (Grammar.canonical()).

methods.name: Five-stage pure-function spine: load, expand, materialize, verify, seal
methods.description: Child projects are generated by five pure-function stages in separate modules, with no interactive state or network access.
methods.evidence: Generation proceeds through five stages, each implemented as a pure function in its own module (src/grammar.py, src/expand.py, src/ma terialize.py, src/verify.py, src/sealing.py).

methods.name: Entropy-free seeded slot selection via SHA-256 digest modulo option count
methods.description: Each slot choice is derived from a digest of seed, slot name, ordinal and options, with no RNG calls in the expansion path.
methods.evidence: a SHA-256 digest of the seed, slot name, ordinal position, and option list, taken modulo the option count, with no call to random.random() or any other entropy source anywhere in the expansion path

methods.name: Tree-hash provenance re-computed from disk by verify_child()
methods.description: materialize() records a tree hash of sorted (path, content_hash) pairs; verify_child() re-reads files and recomputes it rather than trusting the record.
methods.evidence: it re-reads every file listed in provenance.json from disk, recomputes the tree hash from what is actually present, and compares the two.

methods.name: Primitive kernels with analytic checks and a mutation meta-gate
methods.description: Kernels are checked against analytic outputs; a mutation meta-gate (test_meta_teeth.py) asserts per domain that a constant-success stub fails and the real implementation passes.
methods.evidence: a mutation meta-gate (test_meta_teeth.py, parametrized over every known domain) asserts that a constant-success stub fails and that the real implementation passes, for each domain independently.

key_findings: The grammar's nominal product space is 360 cells but only 45 are effective once the 3 presentation/sealing reserved slots are excluded; both are reported.
The paper aims to make completeness, determinism and traceability of generated projects structurally verifiable by re-running code rather than asserting them in prose.
On the example input, iterative gradient descent and the closed-form minimiser agree to within 1e-4.
The reported build has 493 tests at 96.28% coverage, with values injected from a live measurement at render time.
A stated limitation: reserved slots do not yet affect materialization, so distinct seeds can yield different spec hashes but byte-identical children.
key_findings_evidence: Both 360 (nominal) and 45 (effective) are reported in this manuscript side-by-side rather than only the larger, more impressive-looking number
template_autopoiesis exists to make each of these three claims structurally verifiable — checkable by re-running code against the object in question — rather than rhetorically asserted in prose.
On the example input (a diagonal A, c = (1, -1), 200 steps at learning rate 0.1) the two agree to within 1e-4.
distinct seeds can produce a nominally distinct spec_hash while materializing byte-identical children, since only three slots vary output.
